atlas_brief.body: The foundation is complete. Tonight you declared the end of the build phase. From tomorrow, the measure of Atlas is no longer documentation — it is business outcomes. Recovered revenue. Conversations created. Customers won. Time saved. Knowledge accumulated. Better decisions made. Monday was proof the system works: FF1 launched, QPaint deployed, Governance Review done, disk crisis averted, CvC experiment closed with permanent learning, Business Knowledge established. The operating system is ready. Now we prove it. Nicholas tender check-in Wednesday. FF1 reply window open. Let's execute.

recent.title: Curiosity-Led Outreach Retired for Painter Acquisition
recent.summary: CvC experiment closed: 105 painter prospects, zero meaningful replies. Curiosity about an already-known problem is not enough to start conversations with painting business owners. Permanently retired. FF1 is now the primary acquisition hypothesis. Full analysis at cvc-day21/.

recent.title: Lint Prioritisation — Not Every Warning Needs a Fix
recent.summary: James directed that lint findings be prioritised by business impact, not fixed blindly. Four-question test: customers? memory/reasoning? execution? trust? No to all = log, schedule, move on. The 5 placeholder path warnings (6th consecutive lint) deferred indefinitely. Engineering work never takes priority over customer outcomes unless materially improving reliability.

recent.title: Complete Business State — Task Is Not Complete Until All Systems Updated
recent.summary: Atlas was treating email sends as complete when the email was sent. James: 'Airtable should never be forgotten to update.' New standard: task completion requires all operational systems (HQ, Airtable, Activity Log, audit logs, learnings) to reflect reality before the task is marked done.

recent.title: Headquarters data has two sources
recent.summary: The dashboard loads headquarters-data.json for UI content and dash.json for pipeline/activity data. Updating only dash.json left the UI unchanged. Any HQ update touching the main panels must update headquarters-data.json directly.

business_knowledge.description: Permanent business principles. Every completed experiment contributes one. Not documents — knowledge that defines how Not Forgotten operates.

principles.principle: Painters do not respond meaningfully to curiosity-led outreach about quote follow-up.
principles.evidence: 105 prospects, zero meaningful replies across curiosity-only and context-enhanced variants.

principles.principle: Trust and shared experience are stronger opening mechanisms than curiosity for trade business owners.
principles.evidence: CvC null result (curiosity failed). FF1 tests the alternative: founder observations as peer. Active experiment.

principles.principle: Customers do not buy because we follow up. They buy because they become more confident.
principles.evidence: Nicholas Zappacosta engaged after receiving personalised acknowledgment of his government tender — not from a follow-up sequence. Star Painters Adelaide converted through relationship, not cold email.
